rationale: The candidate is a coherent early massing with one dominant compact body and a single carved central void, so it fits the neighborhood_living brief well enough to pass. The plan/orientation respond reasonably to the parcel and the void gives the street edge some public legibility, especially given the verified access edge. However, the silhouette is still mostly a generic rectangular extrusion with a shallow roof recess, so the non-stair silhouette score is lower and the section-program relationship remains modest rather than strongly authored. It reads as a plausible active-ground building, but not yet a highly resolved neighborhood figure.
